grades.evidence: The problem is that agents forget interactions, forcing users to repeatedly re-enter the same details. This system differs by providing a described architecture with memory objects created from interactions, retrieved by relevance, corrected over time, and deleted on request.

The problem is that agents forget, requiring users to re-enter the same details repeatedly. The system's different approach is that it is a described architecture (not a marketing slogan) with structured features: memory objects made from user interactions, some stored on explicit request, retrieved by relevance, corrected over time, and deleted when requested.

No performance numbers are given. What is claimed is structural: memory objects made from your interactions, some on your explicit request, retrieved by relevance, corrected over time, and deleted when you ask.
